summary.zh: 规划开关灰度、清理陈旧开关并审查应急开关
summary.en: Plan flag rollouts, find stale flags and audit kill switches

description.zh: 为开关设计灰度节奏、目标人群和回滚条件，定期扫出长期全开的陈旧开关，并检查应急开关是否真的可用。适合上线新功能、清理开关债，或需要确认一键关停路径的时候。配套脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Plans flag rollouts, targeting and rollback conditions, surfaces stale flags that are always on, and audits whether kill switches still work. Use it before shipping a flag or when flag debt builds up. The scripts need local Python.
